excludedEditorialSpans.text: Now § 9–109. Under the current
version of Article 9, it is possible to take
a security interest in a deposit account,
except for consumer transactions, and many
insurance claims.
a
a
The following states have retained the
prior definition of “good faith,” which does
not include a reference to “the observance
of reasonable commercial standards of fair
dealing”: Alabama, Arizona, Hawaii, Idaho,
Illinois, Indiana, Maryland, Michigan,
Nebraska, New York, Rhode Island, Utah,
and Virginia.
b
b
The bracketed definition of “good faith”
is retained in the states that did not enact
the definition of “good faith” in the Official
Text of UCC § 1–201(b)(20). See footnote a,
supra. The bracketed provision is deleted in
other states.
c
This section is deleted in the 2003
Official Text of the Uniform Commercial
Code in light of UCC § 1–303 (2003), which
covers the same point. Although all states
have enacted the 2003 text of Article 1,
some of those states have nonetheless
redundantly retained this section.
